verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth generates TOTP codes on the device. The evidence points toward local, account-free use: sync is opt-in to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive, the browser extension needs no login, and the probe describes the product as local-first with no API endpoint for token generation. However, no 2FAS Auth doc explicitly says codes work offline or that the mobile app needs no registration; the 'no registration' claim covers 2FAS Pass only. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that Auth codes generate with no network, explicit statement that the Auth app needs no account, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline use.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive
the browser extension does not require nor need any login or password.
local-first by design, no agent-callable endpoint for token generation
